#### What this PR does / why we need it:
This PR adds an integration test for testing feature gate compatibility for the Kubernetes Compatibility Versions [KEP-4330](https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/blob/master/keps/sig-architecture/4330-compatibility-versions/README.md) feature.  This test parses the feature gate information from a test kube-apiserver w/ --emulation-version=\<prior-version\> and hits the /metrics endpoint.  It compares the values it gets from this to the known correct values for that version.  This test is needed as Compatibility Versions guarantees that APIs and feature gate values are correctly emulated properly when using --emulated-version=n-1..3.  This test tests that core functionality of the feature.

issue_context.title: K8s Compatibility Versions (`--emulated-version`) feature should have integration test to validate feature gate compatibility
issue_context.body:
### What would you like to be added?

Currently the K8s Compatibility Versions feature has some tests associated with API compatibility such as `TestEnableEmulationVersion` (https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/test/integration/apiserver/apiserver_test.go#L3149) but no tests associated with feature gate compatibility.  This issue tracks adding feature gate compatibility integration test(s) to fill this testing gap. 

### Why is this needed?

This is needed as currently the Compatibility Versions feature (--emulated-version) has as a goal the ability to allow k8s to emulate a prior (up to n-3) version but the feature gate compatibility that is promised in the feature is currently not tested

/sig api-machinery
/assign
/triage accepted
comments:
Currently in writing such a test I am seeing an issue where when using [testserver.go](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/cmd/kube-apiserver/app/testing/testserver.go) (the integration test kube-apiserver test framework) it seems that the `--emulated-version=v1.31` flag is not properly setting emulated version.  I get different feature gate values when using `--emulated-version=v1.31` with hack/local-up-cluster.sh vs using it in an integration test w/ [testserver.go](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/cmd/kube-apiserver/app/testing/testserver.go)


- Actual cluster @ HEAD w/ --emulated-version=1.31: 
```bash
$ EMULATED_VERSION=1.31 sudo -E hack/local-up-cluster.sh
...
$ kubectl --kubeconfig=/var/run/kubernetes/admin.kubeconfig get --raw /metrics | grep kubernetes_feature_enabled &> ~/out.txt
...
```

From the above, when you account for GA feature gates that were cleaned up and had LockToDefault:true set (see https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/128036 for more info)  this leaves us with the following deltas of interest:


- StrictCostEnforcementForVAP expected value 0, got 1
- StrictCostEnforcementForWebhooks expected value 0, got 1
- AnonymousAuthConfigurableEndpoints expected value 0, got 1
- missing ComponentSLIs
- missing AllowServiceLBStatusOnNonLB

The bottom two are explained by https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/128036 (it is a bug they are missing but IIUC it should be ok to leave as is for now).  This leaves the following:
- StrictCostEnforcementForVAP expected value 0, got 1
- StrictCostEnforcementForWebhooks expected value 0, got 1
- AnonymousAuthConfigurableEndpoints expected value 0, got 1

I'm still trying to understand why these values are different, I believe this has to do with how [testserver.go](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/cmd/kube-apiserver/app/testing/testserver.go) options are set.  It is likely an issue somewhere in:
- https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/cmd/kube-apiserver/app/testing/testserver.go#L206-L208 which sets the emulation version for feature gate and components global registry 
-  possibly https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/staging/src/k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/server/options/server_run_options.go#L377 which I believe is part of the code that is setting the emulation version via flags


I am not sure if doing the following works as intended currently:
```
	server := kubeapiservertesting.StartTestServerOrDie(t,
		&kubeapiservertesting.TestServerInstanceOptions{BinaryVersion: "1.32"},
		[]string{"--emulated-version=kube=1.31"}, framework.SharedEtcd())
	defer server.TearDownFn()
```


but there is a test @ HEAD currently that does this now - `TestEnableEmulationVersion`:
```
func TestEnableEmulationVersion(t *testing.T) {
	server := kubeapiservertesting.StartTestServerOrDie(t,
		&kubeapiservertesting.TestServerInstanceOptions{BinaryVersion: "1.32"},
		[]string{"--emulated-version=kube=1.31"}, framework.SharedEtcd())
	defer server.TearDownFn()
	...
```

TLDR; I am not sure doing the following in an integration tests using testserver.go works properly and I am seeing deltas between using this and setting `--emulated-version=1.31`  using hack/local-up-cluster.sh
```
	server := kubeapiservertesting.StartTestServerOrDie(t,
		&kubeapiservertesting.TestServerInstanceOptions{BinaryVersion: "1.32"},
		[]string{"--emulated-version=kube=1.31"}, framework.SharedEtcd())
```
